title: {name} is after a new deal
text: He's out of contract at season's end and wants security now. On today's form he's worth {ask} a season.

choices.label: Re-sign {first} now
choices.note: We pay over the odds to lock {name} in now.

choices.label: Wait for the off-season

effects.why: You made him wait on a new deal

choices.result: {name} is disappointed, but it can wait for the off-season.

stakes: Extend now: {more_seasons} at {early_price} a season, locked in. Wait, and {name}'s price moves with his form.

title: {name}'s manager is talking him up
text: His manager's on radio saying his client is "weighing up his options".

choices.label: Ring the manager

effects.why: You leaned on his manager in the middle of contract talks

choices.result: You tell the manager to keep it off the radio. It goes quiet, and {first} hears about the call.

choices.label: Ignore it

effects.why: You didn't bite when his manager went on radio

choices.result: You leave it. {first} sees we didn't bite.

title: {name} is asking about next year
text: He wants an answer before the season's out. Is there one more year?

choices.label: Promise him nothing

effects.why: You were straight with him about his future

choices.result: You tell {name} there's no promise of another year.

choices.label: Talk after the season

effects.why: You put off talking about his future

choices.result: {name} takes that as a maybe. He wanted an answer.

title: {name} is asking where he stands
text: He's on a rookie deal and can't get a senior game. His family are asking questions.

effects.why: You told him he was part of the plans
You told him he had to earn his place

title: {name}'s manager has called
text: Other clubs are asking about him. He hasn't forgotten you made him wait.

choices.label: Promise a deal later

effects.why: You told him a deal was coming

choices.result: {name} is reassured, for now. The board hears a deal was promised before the numbers were agreed.

effects.why: You let him test the market

title: {new_club} have approached {name}
text: {name} is out of contract at season's end. {new_club} are building their first list. They can sign anyone out of contract we haven't re-signed. Re-sign him now and he stays.

title: {name}: the paper has him headed interstate
text: A paper has {first} on another club's shopping list. His manager has rung. He's out of contract at season's end. He wants it sorted before Round 1.

choices.label: Wait until Round 1
choices.note: No commitment yet. {first} will ask for what he's worth then. Less if his form drops, more if he improves.

effects.why: You put off his contract talk with another club interested

choices.result: {first} isn't happy to be put off. The paper is still running the story.
